resolution: Startup drain waits for startup and accounts for every child; pre-start drain refuses.
Failed job status preserves dependency identity without reading corrupt snapshots; new launches remain blocked.
Canary startup/failure cleanup stops its owned process group, including a worker ignoring SIGTERM.
Hung MCP frontend cleanup forces termination and waits for process exit, including initialization failures.
review.verification: 25 focused tests plus a 1,219-test full suite passed; real child-process checks verified startup-failure and hung-MCP cleanup.

limitations: Linux and Node 20 release gate remains separate.
Native Desktop UI approval, lineage and handoff are not certified.
Detached parent wake remains unavailable; completion inbox and explicit parent join are durable.
Write workers are not automatically retried or merged. Existing read-only retry policies remain supported.
Final versioned package, fresh-install/upgrade and artifact reproducibility checks remain release gates.

runtimeSource.algorithm: SHA-256 of lexically sorted recursive regular src and bin files plus package.json, excluding bin/nelos-verify-owned-plan; append relative path + newline, bytes, newline for each file.
